description: NousResearch Hermes Agent with Kori-x real-time dashboard. Built-in s6-overlay supervision runs the gateway, built-in dashboard, and Kori-x monitoring UI together in one container.
notes:
Set Proxy Port to 5173 for the Kori-x monitoring dashboard, or 9119 for the built-in config/session dashboard, or 8642 for raw API access.

Default model: qwen2.5-coder:7b-32k (local Ollama via LiteLLM proxy at 172.17.0.1:4001).

Mount a persistent volume at /opt/data to preserve config, API keys, sessions, skills, and memories across workspace restarts.

Ports: 8642 (OpenAI-compatible API + health), 9119 (built-in dashboard), 5173 (Kori-x UI), 3001 (Kori-x WebSocket), 3002 (Kori-x wiki API).
